data.name: Lokman
data.long_meaning: The name Lokman is derived from the Arabic word 'lakama' which means 'to speak' or 'to convey'. This name is attributed to the character Lokman Hafiz Ibn Zaid, who was a wise and intelligent speaker in Islamic history. The name is therefore symbolic of one who is eloquent and knowledgeable.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and understanding. A name for someone who is highly intelligent, thoughtful, and insightful.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Lokman are expressive, creative, and sociable. They possess a strong communicative ability and thrive in environments where they can share their ideas and opinions. They are also natural problem solvers and have a deep understanding of the world around them.
